Kettle & Kiln

Kettle & Kiln is a two-person pottery studio in Jaipur making hand-thrown stoneware for home kitchens. Every piece is food safe, dishwasher safe and fired twice at 1240 degrees. We have shipped to 4100 homes since 2019 and we take commissions for restaurants.

What we make

Mugs, serving bowls, dinner plates and teapots. Each batch is limited to 40 pieces because both of us throw every piece by hand. Glazes are mixed in the studio and are lead free.

Get started

Browse the current batch, or write to the studio about a commission. Orders are packed within two working days.
